subtopics.content: a. Operations in different number bases from 2 to 10
subtopics.objective: Perform the four basic operations (multiplication, addition, subtraction and division) in different number bases.

subtopics.content: b. Conversion from one base to another including fractional parts
subtopics.objective: Convert one base to another.

subtopics.content: c. Modular arithmetic
subtopics.objective: Perform operations in modular arithmetic.

subtopics.content: a. Fractions and decimals
subtopics.objective: Perform the basic operations (multiplication, addition, subtraction and division) on fractions and decimals.

subtopics.content: b. Significant figures
subtopics.objective: Express numbers to a specified number of significant figures.

subtopics.content: c. Decimal places
subtopics.objective: Express numbers to specified decimal places.

subtopics.content: d. Percentage errors
subtopics.objective: Calculate percentage error.

subtopics.content: e. Simple interest
subtopics.objective: Calculate simple interest.

subtopics.content: f. Profit and loss percent
subtopics.objective: Calculate profit and loss percentages.

subtopics.content: g. Ratio, proportion and rate
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving ratio, proportion and rate.

subtopics.content: h. Shares and value added tax (VAT)
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving shares and VAT.

subtopics.content: a. Laws of indices
subtopics.objective: Apply the laws of indices in calculations.

subtopics.content: b. Equations involving indices
subtopics.objective: Solve equations involving indices.

subtopics.content: c. Standard form
subtopics.objective: Apply standard form in calculations involving numbers.

subtopics.content: d. Laws of logarithm
subtopics.objective: Apply the laws of logarithms in calculations.

subtopics.content: e. Logarithm of any positive number to a given base
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving logarithms in different bases.

subtopics.content: f. Change of bases in logarithm and application
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving logarithms in different bases.

subtopics.content: g. Relationship between indices and logarithm
subtopics.objective: Establish the relationship between indices and logarithms in solving problems.

subtopics.content: h. Surds
subtopics.objective: Simplify and rationalize surds, and perform basic operations on surds.

subtopics.content: a. Types of sets
subtopics.objective: Identify types of sets, including empty, universal, complement, subset, finite, infinite and disjoint sets.

subtopics.content: b. Algebra of sets
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving the cardinality of sets and solve set problems using symbols.

subtopics.content: c. Venn diagrams and their applications
subtopics.objective: Use Venn diagrams to solve problems involving not more than three sets.

subtopics.content: a. Change of subject of formula
subtopics.objective: Find the subject of the formula of a given equation.

subtopics.content: b. Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of polynomials
subtopics.objective: Multiply and divide polynomials of degree not more than three and determine values of defined and undefined expressions.

subtopics.content: c. Factorization of polynomials of degree not exceeding 3
subtopics.objective: Apply the factor and remainder theorems to factorize a given expression. Factorize by regrouping, difference of two squares, perfect squares and cubic expressions.

subtopics.content: d. Roots of polynomials not exceeding degree 3
subtopics.objective: Determine the roots of polynomials of degree not exceeding three.

subtopics.content: e. Factor and remainder theorems
subtopics.objective: Apply factor and remainder theorems to factorize a given expression.

subtopics.content: f. Simultaneous equations including one linear and one quadratic
subtopics.objective: Solve simultaneous equations involving one linear equation and one quadratic equation.

subtopics.content: g. Graphs of polynomials of degree not greater than 3
subtopics.objective: Interpret graphs of polynomials, including applications to maximum and minimum values.

subtopics.content: a. Direct variation
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving direct variation.

subtopics.content: b. Inverse variation
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving inverse variation.

subtopics.content: c. Joint variation
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving joint variation.

subtopics.content: d. Partial variation
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving partial variation.

subtopics.content: e. Percentage increase and decrease
subtopics.objective: Solve problems on percentage increase and decrease in variation.

subtopics.content: a. Analytical and graphical solutions of linear inequalities
subtopics.objective: Solve problems on linear inequalities and interpret graphs of inequalities.

subtopics.content: b. Quadratic inequalities with integral roots only
subtopics.objective: Solve problems on quadratic inequalities and interpret graphs of inequalities.

subtopics.content: a. nth term of a progression
subtopics.objective: Determine the nth term of a progression.

subtopics.content: b. Sum of A.P. and G.P.
subtopics.objective: Compute the sum of an arithmetic progression (A.P.) and a geometric progression (G.P.), including the sum to infinity of a given G.P.

subtopics.content: a. Properties of closure, commutativity, associativity and distributivity
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving closure, commutativity, associativity and distributivity.

subtopics.content: b. Identity and inverse elements (simple cases only)
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving identity and inverse elements.

subtopics.content: a. Algebra of matrices not exceeding 3 × 3
subtopics.objective: Perform the basic operations (multiplication, addition, subtraction and division) on matrices.

subtopics.content: b. Determinants of matrices not exceeding 3 × 3
subtopics.objective: Calculate determinants of matrices.

subtopics.content: c. Inverses of 2 × 2 matrices
subtopics.objective: Compute inverses of 2 × 2 matrices.

subtopics.content: Note: Excluding quadratic and higher degree equations.
subtopics.objective: Apply the stated restrictions when solving problems involving matrices and determinants.

subtopics.content: a. Properties of angles and lines
subtopics.objective: Identify various types of lines and angles.

subtopics.content: b. Polygons: triangles, quadrilaterals and general polygons
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving polygons.

subtopics.content: c. Circles: angle properties, cyclic quadrilaterals and intersecting chords
subtopics.objective: Calculate angles using circle theorems.

subtopics.content: d. Construction
subtopics.objective: Identify construction procedures for special angles, e.g. 30°, 45°, 60°, 75° and 90°.

subtopics.content: a. Lengths and areas of plane geometrical figures
subtopics.objective: Calculate the perimeters and areas of triangles, quadrilaterals, circles and composite figures.

subtopics.content: b. Lengths of arcs and chords of a circle
subtopics.objective: Find the lengths of arcs and chords of a circle.

subtopics.content: c. Perimeters and areas of sectors and segments of circles
subtopics.objective: Calculate the perimeters and areas of sectors and segments of circles.

subtopics.content: d. Surface areas and volumes of simple solids and composite figures
subtopics.objective: Calculate total surface areas and volumes of cuboids, cylinders, cones, pyramids, prisms, spheres and composite figures.

subtopics.content: e. The earth as a sphere: longitudes and latitudes
subtopics.objective: Determine the distance between two points on the earth's surface.

subtopics.content: Locus in 2 dimensions based on geometric principles relating to lines and curves
subtopics.objective: Identify and interpret loci relating to parallel lines, perpendicular bisectors, angle bisectors and circles.

subtopics.content: a. Midpoint and gradient of a line segment
subtopics.objective: Determine the midpoint and gradient of a line segment.

subtopics.content: b. Distance between two points
subtopics.objective: Find the distance between two points.

subtopics.content: c. Parallel and perpendicular lines
subtopics.objective: Identify conditions for parallelism and perpendicularity.

subtopics.content: d. Equations of straight lines
subtopics.objective: Find the equation of a line in the two-point form, point-slope form, slope-intercept form and general form.

subtopics.content: a. Trigonometrical ratios of angles
subtopics.objective: Calculate the sine, cosine and tangent of angles between -360° and 360°.

subtopics.content: b. Angles of elevation and depression
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving angles of elevation and depression.

subtopics.content: c. Bearings
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving bearings.

subtopics.content: d. Areas and solutions of triangles
subtopics.objective: Apply trigonometric formulae to find areas of triangles and solve problems involving triangles.

subtopics.content: e. Graphs of sine and cosine
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving sine and cosine graphs.

subtopics.content: f. Sine and cosine formulae
subtopics.objective: Apply sine and cosine formulae to solve trigonometric problems, including problems involving special angles such as 30°, 45°, 60°, 75°, 90°, 105° and 135°.

subtopics.content: a. Limit of a function
subtopics.objective: Find the limit of a function.

subtopics.content: b. Differentiation of explicit algebraic and simple trigonometrical functions: sine, cosine and tangent
subtopics.objective: Differentiate explicit algebraic and simple trigonometrical functions.

subtopics.content: a. Rate of change
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving applications of rate of change.

subtopics.content: b. Maxima and minima
subtopics.objective: Solve problems involving applications of maxima and minima.

subtopics.content: a. Integration of explicit algebraic and simple trigonometrical functions
subtopics.objective: Solve problems of integration involving algebraic and simple trigonometric functions.

subtopics.content: b. Area under the curve
subtopics.objective: Calculate the area under the curve in simple cases only.

subtopics.content: a. Frequency distribution
subtopics.objective: Identify and interpret frequency distribution tables.

subtopics.content: b. Histogram, bar chart and pie chart
subtopics.objective: Interpret information on histograms, bar charts and pie charts.

subtopics.content: a. Mean, mode and median of ungrouped and grouped data (simple cases only)
subtopics.objective: Calculate the mean, mode and median of ungrouped and grouped data in simple cases only.

subtopics.content: b. Cumulative frequency
subtopics.objective: Use an ogive to find the median, quartiles and percentiles.

subtopics.content: Range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation
subtopics.objective: Calculate the range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation of ungrouped and grouped data.

subtopics.content: a. Linear and circular arrangements
subtopics.objective: Solve simple problems involving permutation and combination.

subtopics.content: b. Arrangements involving repeated objects
subtopics.objective: Solve simple problems involving permutation and combination, including arrangements involving repeated objects.

subtopics.content: a. Experimental probability (tossing of coin, throwing of a dice, etc.)
subtopics.objective: Solve simple problems in probability using experimental examples such as tossing a coin and throwing a die.

subtopics.content: b. Addition and multiplication of probabilities (mutual and independent cases)
subtopics.objective: Solve simple problems in probability, including addition and multiplication of probabilities.
